shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
repeated motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organised into horizontal registers with repeated motifs in a row, and both include limbs/hands rendered in shallow relief, but A depicts a naturalistic procession of bearded human figures in pleated robes with detailed hair, headgear, spears and rosette borders, while B depicts schematic animals (a quadruped, a bird-like creature, a snake-like form) and abstract signs with no human figures except disembodied arms. The correspondences are generic (relief, registers, profile animals) and of the kind any relief-carving tradition could produce independently.
